name: icons
title: Icons
description: 25 Aqua icons: things as 10.0–10.3 drew them (computer, home, mail, lock, a check box, a light bulb, an open box…) with a 1px hairline, and Olivia's own pictures for Preview, QuickTime, Music, Document, Trash, Folder, Heart and Star, loaded when first drawn; the same in every tone except Folder, Heart and Star. `lucideToPack` names the one to use for a lucide-react icon.
